translations.en: It appeared to be a corpse.
It had been so thoroughly eaten that you could not tell what it was.
Blood!
It must have been there quite some time,
for it had already turned black.
It had probably only just died.
The mangled carcass of a beast lay on the ground.
Something smelled.
It was a sour stench, like rotting meat.
There was a pungent smell.
You could not help grimacing.
Something cold struck your back!
You looked up. Apparently, a drop of water had fallen on you.
...You could feel someone watching.
You looked around, but no one was there.
Perhaps from the direction of town,
you could hear a dog barking in the distance.
You tripped on a stone.
It was a turtle.
You were surprised to find an ordinary animal
in a place like this.
Your foot sinks into the mud.

translations.en: Was it your imagination?
You could hear a woman's voice from somewhere.
...You were getting hungry.
A delicious smell, rather like stew, wafted from somewhere.
A bird took flight nearby.
Something like an old flyer lay at your feet.
"Eggs at bargain prices!"
Had it belonged to someone who once lived here?
There was a statue that seemed to resemble a snake.
Perhaps it belonged to someone who used to live here.
Some chipped dishes lay there.
Perhaps they belonged to the previous residents.
Old books lay scattered about.
The instant you picked one up,
it crumbled to pieces.
You could hear something howling in the distance.
What appeared to be an old advertisement lay at your feet.
"Huge sale on arms and armor!!"
Whoops.
You nearly stepped on a spider.
Small though it was, it was alive.
Better not kill it needlessly.
The path was muddy.
Your feet might get stuck.
Part of the ground at your feet was a different color.
What will you do?
Walk across without worrying
Go around
A trap had been set there!
Something like an old journal lay on the ground.
Read it?

translations.en: Read it
Ignore it
The handwriting looked limp and weary.
"I just want to go home."
"...I'm sleepy."
An old note lies on the ground.

translations.en: "I can't... I'm sleepy..."
The last part was written in such an illegible scrawl
that you could not read it.
The wind seemed to be blowing east.
You could hear voices from somewhere to the south.
Something was carved in small letters on the wall.
"Thank you for your hard work."
Some words were carved on the wall.
"Do not try to control everything.
Accept everything."
The wind was blowing southeast.
Something was carved on the wall.
"I have a feeling I'll be back here again."
Something was written at your feet.
"How many times have I passed through here?"
"It's too soon to relax!!"
Small letters were carved at your feet.
"Is this our first meeting? Or should I say, welcome back?"
